title: Proposal: working together on KCNQ2-related disorders research

sentences.text: A proposal to work together on research into KCNQ2-related disorders.
We are writing to the KCNQ2 Cure Alliance because you support families affected by KCNQ2-related disorders.
We have not met yet, and we would value your guidance.
Published work points to a dominant-negative effect and loss of function, while a minority of variants act by gain of function, so the mechanism is contested.
People with KCNQ2 changes are included in Citizen Health and the COMBINEDBrain Biorepository, and a registry and natural history study of epilepsy-dyskinesia syndromes is recruiting.
Two cohort studies of KCNQ2 epilepsy have an unknown status.
A phase 3 XEN496 (ezogabine) trial and its extension were terminated by sponsor decision, not for safety, and the trial excluded gain-of-function variants.
Evidence on sodium channel blocking medicines is also marked as contested.
We would propose a study on [research question about KCNQ2-related disorders], shaped with your community from the start.
Its design, sites and funding are still to be settled: [study details].

sections.heading: What we would ask of you

sentences.text: Would you be open to discussing this idea with us?
If so, we would like to learn how your community might take part, always with proper consent and ethics approval.
We are not asking for any personal information about patients or families.
If this is of interest, could we arrange a short call at a time that suits you?
